last_review.summary: FE-005 meets the task criteria and architecture rules. The diff stays within the allowed SSE infrastructure paths, preserves memory-only authentication, implements incremental parsing, resumable sequencing, typed terminal outcomes, bounded retries, and cancellation cleanup. Live transport remains unwired. Harness build and contract-hash verification passed.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; the contract hash check and the build are the deterministic gates.
src/contracts/ is vendored read-only from noktos-agent-backend at version 1.0.0 and verified against contracts.lock.
The access token lives in memory only: never in browser storage, never in a URL, never rendered or logged.
Frontend controls are user experience; the backend is the authorization boundary.
Development runs against fixtures until FE-013 swaps in the live transport.
